subject: Close date rescue: MAP rebaseline + audit trail for Aurora pilot
body:
From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@aurora-sys.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@aurora-sys.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora pilot MAP + timeline questions

Karthik,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday — the platform looked promising. We mapped your MAP to our internal milestones and a couple of things came up on our end that will likely push the go-live by a few weeks unless we adjust the plan:

- Compliance audit on our side (SOC2 evidence) targeted for the week of 6/4
- Internal procurement window closes 5/31; procurement needs explicit proof of data handling and a sample eval with our dataset

Can we get a short version of the MAP focused on evidence we can hand to procurement (SLA + SOC2 statement + evaluation checklist)? Also, if Redwood can commit to a one-week extension on the trial and a small credit if the go-live slips, that would help us secure exec approval.

I attached our internal evaluation checklist — if you can fill gaps in the MAP and confirm the audit artifacts, we'd appreciate it.

Best,
Samantha
Head of AI Integrations
Aurora Systems

--- attachment stub: Aurora_EvalChecklist.pdf (1 page) ---

----

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@aurora-sys.com>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@aurora-sys.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora pilot MAP + timeline questions

Samantha — thanks for the clear summary. We can definitely tighten the MAP for procurement and include an evidence pack. Quick answers up front:

- SOC2: we will attach the SOC2 letter and point to the audit evidence inventory (see attachment).
- Eval: we’ll run a 3-day focused run on a representative subset you provided, produce token/latency cost estimates and an output-quality report tied to your pass/fail checklist.
- Credits: I can approve a $7k pilot credit for Aurora if procurement requires a clear cushion; will need Marissa to sign off for contract amendment.

Proposed immediate steps:
1) I’ll send a slimmed MAP and an evidence pack by EOD Tuesday 5/21.
2) Run the focused eval 5/22–5/24 (our infra reserved).
3) If procurement needs a DocuSign amendment, I’ll loop legal and send a draft; Marissa — cc’d — can you confirm the credit approval lane?

I attached the draft MAP (Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx) and the SOC2 letter.

Thanks — I’ll follow up after internal alignment.

— Karthik
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

--- attachment stubs: Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2_letter.pdf ---

----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Aurora pilot MAP + timeline questions — credit & procurement handling

Karthik — saw your note. Quick internal:

- Credit: Approve $7k pilot credit. Log to deal and ask finance to mark as "pilot credit — conditional" until contract signed.
- Contract amendment: Legal can ship a short DocuSign amendment with the credit clause and a 30-day post-go-live review. Monica, can you run procurement playbook / template and confirm what artifacts procurement typically needs?
- MAP: ensure the evidence pack has: SOC2 letter, data flow diagram, encryption/KMS note, retention policy, a sample eval CSV with prompt IDs and scoring rubric.

Keep client-facing comms tight — avoid promising SLA changes beyond the standard Dedicated offering. If procurement pushes a hard 5/31 deadline and needs immediate artifacts, Karthik, escalate and I’ll join the call.

Marissa
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

----

From: procurement@aurora-sys.com
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Samantha Ruiz <samantha@aurora-sys.com>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora pilot — procurement hold (info request)

Karthik / Samantha,

Procurement has put the request on hold pending the following:
1) Evidence of log retention and query audit (sample logs).
2) Confirmation of data residency controls for pilot.
3) Signed credit amendment (DocuSign) or formal approval note from Redwood finance.

If those three items are provided by EOD Monday 5/28 we can keep the internal approval window open. Otherwise the earliest procurement slot pushes to mid-June.

Procurement Team
Aurora Systems

--- forwarded message header included below when we reply with evidence ---

----

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@aurora-sys.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@aurora-sys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 May 2028 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora pilot — procurement hold (info request)

Team — escalation summary and ask (short):

What happened: procurement hit a gate — asks for log samples + residency confirmation + signed amendment. This creates a realistic risk of the go-live sliding from 6/10 -> mid-June unless we deliver by EOD today and procurement keeps slot open.

What I’m sending now (attachments + links):
- SOC2_letter.pdf (signed)
- Aurora_EvalChecklist_filled.xlsx (focused eval results + scoring)
- Sample audit log extract (redacted) — attached as "audit_sample_redacted.log" in the DocuSign/Drive packet
- DocuSign amendment link (credit clause) — needs e-sign from Procurement

Requested action from Redwood ops/legal:
- Marissa: confirm finance sign-off logged and legal to push DocuSign by 12:00 PST today.
- Monica: confirm the data residency statement (one paragraph) for procurement to include in the amendment.

If procurement signs the amendment and we deliver artifacts today, Aurora keeps their internal slot and target close remains 6/10. If not, we should prepare comms to Aurora execs and offer a revised MAP rebaseline (recommended new target: 6/24) and a 2-week uplift credit as a goodwill gesture.

I’m on standby to hop on the call with procurement at 14:00 PST.

Thanks — Karthik
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

--- attachment stubs: Aurora_EvalChecklist_filled.xlsx, audit_sample_redacted.log ---
